pages.title: Diprotodon
pages.text: $(o)Diprotodon$() ($(o)Diprotodon optatum$()) is the largest marsupial known to have lived, about the size of a rhinoceros. It roamed much of Australia during the Pleistocene.$(br2)It browsed on shrubs and grazed in open woodland and grassland, and fossil trackways show its feet turned inward as it walked.$(br2)Diprotodon may have moved in small groups, and some evidence suggests it made seasonal migrations.
